# Requirements Quality Checklist: Crowdfund Frontend UI

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements writing — validate that the feature's requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and ready for implementation (this is NOT an implementation verification list)
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · scope also covers [plan.md](../plan.md), [tasks.md](../tasks.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus areas (selected)**: Cross-artifact scope (spec + plan + tasks), funds safety & error-message quality as mandatory gating emphasis, standard depth.
**Gating items (funds safety emphasis)**: CHK001, CHK006, CHK011, CHK017, CHK025, CHK029 — resolve these first if triaging.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are error-handling requirements defined for every funds-moving action (pledge, unpledge, claim, refund) with each named failure cause requiring its own user-facing message? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013/§SC-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are wallet-state requirements (disconnected, connecting, no-wallet-installed, wrong-network) specified for every state-changing action, including that browsing stays fully functional in all non-connected states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005/§FR-015/§US1.3]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all four list data states (loading, empty catalogue, empty search result, error) specified with required behavior including retry affordance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014/§FR-001/§US1.5–6]
- [ ] CHK004 Are campaign text requirements documented as launch validation rules — title and description non-empty with explicit maximum sizes (80/500 bytes)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006/§Clarifications Q1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "plain-language explanation" for blocked actions quantified (e.g., raw revert strings never shown; one distinct message per blocking cause)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012/§SC-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Are launch validation rules stated as specific, individually testable bounds (goal > 0, start not in past, end ≥ start, ≤ 90 days, text limits) rather than general guidance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006/§SC-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "no perceptible freeze" in SC-006 given an objective interpretation or measurement method, or flagged as open to interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "baseline accessibility" defined with concrete, checkable properties (keyboard operation, visible focus, AA contrast, resizable text) rather than a vague promise? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021/§SC-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "retro fidelity" tied to specific observable design attributes (palette, bevel direction, title-bar color, font classes, terminal colors) rather than subjective impression? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017/§SC-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Are status vocabulary terms (upcoming, live, successful, failed, cancelled, claimed, refunded) defined with precise transition conditions, and are the list's filter tabs consistent with that vocabulary including cancelled-item handling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003/§FR-001/§US1.4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are funds-eligibility rules consistent across all three sources — spec FRs, data-model action matrix, and contracts/crowdfund-contract-interface.md — with no rule differing in condition or outcome? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008…§FR-011; data-model.md; contracts/]
- [ ] CHK012 Does tasks.md cover every requirement FR-001…FR-021 without orphan FRs, and do story labels map 1:1 to the spec's four user stories? [Traceability, tasks.md]
- [ ] CHK013 Are clarification decisions (injected-only wallets, public-testnet default, contract extension for title/description) consistently reflected across FRs and Assumptions with no contradictory leftover statements (e.g., the original "contract will not be modified")? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications/§Assumptions/§FR-015]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the canonical contribution terminology (pledge / unpledge / contribution / backer) used consistently across spec, data-model, and contract interface docs, or are the synonyms explicitly reconciled? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities; data-model.md; contracts/]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can each of SC-001…SC-008 be measured objectively by a non-implementation-aware reviewer (no framework/tool references, numeric thresholds present)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001…§SC-008]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-004's "100% of blocked actions" verifiable — is the complete enumerable set of blocking causes listed somewhere (eligibility matrix) so 100% has a defined denominator? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004; data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-005's inspection scope ("90% of inspected UI elements") given a sampling/inspection definition, and are SC-001/SC-002's user-test conditions (task scripts, environment) specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001/§SC-002/§SC-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the ground truth for SC-007's "match exactly" comparison identified in requirements terms (what counts as the authoritative recorded value)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are all five scenario classes covered by requirements — primary (browse, fund, launch), alternate (unpledge, cancel, filter/search), exception (rejections, wrong network), recovery (retry after load failure), and non-functional (accessibility, performance, fidelity)? [Coverage, Spec §US1–§US4/§Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are creator-vs-backer permission requirements covered for every action (launch/cancel/claim = creator; pledge/unpledge/refund = backer rules), including creator-pledging-to-own-campaign behavior? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007/§FR-010/§FR-011; data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for mid-flight transitions (campaign starts or ends while an action is pending) with the required specific messaging? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases §2]
- [ ] CHK022 Are first-visit requirements specified for a visitor with no wallet installed at all (browse works, connect guidance shown)? [Coverage, Spec §US1/§Edge Cases §12]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are display edge-case requirements defined for overfunding (>100%), zero/negative/non-numeric/absurd amounts, and cancelled-campaign id gaps — each with expected behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases/§FR-004]
- [ ] CHK024 Are duplicate/late funds-action requirements defined with expected messaging — double claim, refund attempt when goal was met, pledge/unpledge after end, refund with zero stake? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010/§FR-011/§US3.6/§Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 Are safety requirements documented for silent-failure prevention: wrong-network detection with guidance, unknown-revert fallback message, and confirmation-before-totals-update on every write? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015/§FR-013/§FR-008/§SC-004]
- [ ] CHK026 Are accessibility requirements specified for ALL interactive elements with objective pass conditions (not spot-checked examples only)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021/§SC-008]
- [ ] CHK027 Are performance requirements quantified with thresholds for both first load (3s) and interaction responsiveness (filter/search/paging) under the stated scale (hundreds of campaigns)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006/§FR-001; plan.md Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the supported responsive range for layout requirements stated concretely (narrow laptop → wide desktop) with the "no overlap/clipping" pass condition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020/§US4.4]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Are external dependencies documented with their failure expectations — existing contract behavior as fixed input, contract extension as in-scope change, injected wallet availability, single pledge token, no backend, testnet environment? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions; plan.md Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK030 Are spec assumptions consistent with plan.md Technical Context and research.md decisions (networks, wallet scope, storage N/A, testing approach), with no decision living in only one document? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions; plan.md; research.md]
- [ ] CHK031 Is an end-to-end requirement traceability scheme established (FR IDs → task IDs → quickstart scenario numbers) sufficient for the final FR walk-through? [Traceability, tasks.md; quickstart.md]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK032 Are remaining vague adjectives quantified or explicitly accepted — "friendly empty-state", "readable", "comfortably clickable", "typical home broadband"? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1.5/§FR-004/§FR-020/§SC-006]
- [ ] CHK033 Are spec and supporting documents free of conflicting duplicate statements (tab lists, scenario numbering, duration limits, byte caps) — or is one source declared authoritative? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001/§FR-006; data-model.md; quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the low-impact items left open by /speckit.clarify (contribution-terminology canonicalization, uptime expectation) either resolved in the spec or explicitly recorded as deferred? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications; clarify report]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Gating priority for funds-safety emphasis: CHK001, CHK006, CHK011, CHK017, CHK025, CHK029
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK034); 34 items total
